_comment: Committed PDK + tool defaults for the layout evidence under layout/.
This is the layout-verification sibling of design/pdk.json and
sim/pdk.json -- deliberately a SEPARATE file, per design/pdk.json's own
comment block precedent ('when a harness lands it brings its own
pdk.json'). open_pdks_commit below MUST match design/pdk.json's and
sim/pdk.json's exactly -- verified 2026-09-05, all three read
c6d73a35f524070e85faff4a6a9eef49553ebc2b.
variant           sky130 flavor directory used to generate/verify
every layout/ evidence directory below
open_pdks_commit  provenance pin, matches design/pdk.json + sim/pdk.json
klt_deck          the klayout-tools (`klt`) rule-deck name resolved for
this PDK family (--deck sky130 on every klt drc /
klt extract / klt lvs invocation under layout/)
klt_version_pin   the klt build this evidence was last generated/
verified against, from `klt version --format json`.
A provenance pin, not a hard gate, same as
open_pdks_commit above -- re-verifying with a
different klt is expected to happen and should update
this pin plus the affected evidence directories
together. NOTE the pin has moved BACKWARDS in
package-version order (0.4.0 -> 0.3.0+gc6dbf66c53c6):
the installed klt build genuinely churns between
sessions in this environment, so treat this field as
'what actually produced the committed evidence', not
as a monotonic version floor. Each artifact carries
its own provenance.klt_version, which is the
authoritative per-file record.
ci_klt_install    what .github/workflows/pdk-nightly.yml's layout-check
job actually installs, per issue #36. klt_version_pin
above (a dev snapshot, 'g<hash>' suffix) has no PyPI
artifact -- klayout-tools is only published at tagged
releases (0.1.0-0.4.0 as of 2026-09-05) -- so CI pins
to the latest *tagged* PyPI release instead of trying
to reproduce the exact dev-snapshot commit. Verified
2026-09-05: klt 0.4.0 from PyPI reproduces
layout/ro_buf/'s committed evidence byte-for-byte.
Same 'provenance pin, not a hard gate' status as
open_pdks_commit/klt_version_pin above -- if a future
PyPI release makes layout-check fail against otherwise
unchanged committed evidence, that is real signal
(klt regressed against this repo's evidence, exactly
the klayout-tools#1491 failure mode), not a config
bug to silence.
